h: Apple will open its 7th India store in Hyderabad on 10 December, with a pearl-themed logo for the 'City of Pearls'
k: The new store is at Lake Shore Mall in Kukatpally. It comes as Apple India's profit jumped 66% to ₹5,311 crore last year.

h: Maharashtra FDA suspends a Zepto dark store's licence after finding live cockroaches, and fines Blinkit ₹11 lakh
k: Food safety officials also suspended the licence of a BigBasket warehouse in Navi Mumbai, as quick-commerce hygiene comes under the spotlight.

h: WhatsApp will sell international data eSIMs inside the app, working with Reliance Jio and Verizon
k: Travellers will be able to buy and install a data plan for another country in a few taps, without leaving WhatsApp. Prices are not out yet.

h: Supreme Court orders separate 'HIGH FAT', 'HIGH SUGAR' and 'HIGH SALT' warnings on the front of packaged foods
k: The court went further than food regulator FSSAI's plan, asking for a separate warning for each nutrient. It is a big change for chips, biscuit and drink brands.

h: Uber names former Zomato food delivery CEO Rakesh Ranjan as its India and South Asia president
k: He joins on 4 January 2027 from Allen Online, filling the job left when Prabhjet Singh moved to OpenAI.

h: Parliament called back for a special sitting from 30 November, with the bill for 850 Lok Sabha seats and women's quota expected
k: The Lok Sabha meets on Monday and the Rajya Sabha on 2 December. A similar constitutional amendment failed in April, short of a two-thirds majority.

h: India's July–September GDP data comes out on Monday, and economists expect growth of about 7.6%
k: Forecasts range from 7.2% to 7.8%. Growth was 7.8% in April–June, but a weak monsoon has hit farming.

h: Loan EMIs may rise again: over 90% of economists expect the RBI to raise the repo rate to 5.75% on 4 December
k: Retail inflation hit a two-year high of 6.09% in October, above the RBI's comfort zone. Markets see a small chance of an even bigger hike.

h: India says it has no 'excess capacity' in any sector and wants the US tariff threat settled in trade-deal talks
k: The commerce ministry said the US notice, which proposes tariffs of up to 25%, is 'under examination'.

h: Tamil Nadu gives male government employees 15 days of paternity leave
k: Chief Minister Vijay announced the change on 26 November, and an order has been issued. Women staff already get a year of maternity leave.

h: Two Italian technicians killed in Kuwait by debris from intercepted drones; Italy and Kuwait point at Iran, which denies it
k: The EU's Ursula von der Leyen said Europe must 'step up pressure on Iran'. It is the second reported attack on Kuwait this month.

h: Ukraine peace talks are 'at a certain impasse' over territory, says US envoy Jared Kushner; Zelensky asks for four-way talks
k: Trump's team wants a new round before 25 December, while Kyiv wants Europe at the table with Russia and the US.

h: Iraq moves to take control of Kurdish oil fields and borders, saying 200,000+ barrels a day are smuggled; big protests in Erbil
k: Iraq's top court backed Baghdad. Kurdish leaders call it a 'red line', and national talks are set for 1 December.

h: Congo's Ebola outbreak passes 12,000 confirmed cases, the fastest-growing on record, as fighting slows the response
k: The rare Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine. Only 15% of new cases come from people already being tracked.

h: IndiaMART settles its court fight with OpenAI over being left out of ChatGPT's answers
k: The B2B marketplace had accused ChatGPT of skipping its listings while showing rivals. Terms of the deal were not disclosed.

h: Urban Company starts selling its own air conditioners, with pre-bookings from ₹55,499 and a 5-year warranty that covers gas refills
k: The home-services company says it designed the AC around problems seen in 1.8 crore AC service jobs. Its shares rose 3.8%.

h: Fintech Kiwi spent ₹105 crore on ads in FY26 to earn ₹16 crore in revenue
k: The UPI credit card startup spent ₹9.66 for every ₹1 it earned, and its loss doubled to ₹129.5 crore.

h: Funding round-up: Finnable raises ₹405 crore, jet-engine startup Green Aero gets $14 million, and GIVA ₹90 crore
k: Lender Finnable is profitable, Green Aero builds engines for fast drones, and jewellery brand GIVA is opening more stores.

h: US regulator lets SpaceX launch up to 1 million satellites for 'Starmind', its plan for AI data centres in space
k: Each solar-powered satellite would be about 70 m across. The first must be working by November 2033.

h: Nvidia stops AI server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia under new US export rules
k: The rules aim to stop Chinese firms renting AI computing power in the region. One executive called it 'sheer chaos'.

h: SAP weighs cutting at least 10,000 jobs, about 9% of staff, as it reshapes itself around AI
k: The plan is not final. Engineering and sales are the main focus, Bloomberg reported.

h: India launches Chariot-1, AI models built from scratch for Indian languages under the IndiaAI Mission
k: The release includes a language model and a text-to-speech model covering English and 10 Indian languages.

h: X adds its first parental controls for teens, and New York bans AI chatbot toys for 5 years
k: Parents can now set screen-time limits on X for 13–17-year-olds. New York is the second US state to ban AI-powered toys.

h: Sensex adds 390 points to 84,328 as IT stocks jump; HCL Tech gains 6.4% while the rupee slips to 92.44
k: Nifty IT rose 3.66% on Thursday. Brent oil climbed 2% to $96.57 on Gulf supply worries.

h: IPO watch: Crystal Crop lists 3% above issue price, Foodlink F&B is fully booked on day 1, and Mahanadi Coalfields debuts today
k: Coal India's Mahanadi unit lists on Friday, with the grey market pointing to a flat start.

h: Christchurch Test: India strike 3 times without a run as New Zealand slip from 110/1 to 110/4 on Day 1
k: Debutant Gurnoor Brar took a wicket on the last ball before lunch, and Akash Deep removed Latham and Ravindra.

h: Gukesh and Sindarov draw a 60-move Game 3; the World Chess Championship is level at 1.5–1.5
k: Gukesh surprised his opponent in the opening, then had to hold on in a tense endgame. Game 4 is on Saturday with Gukesh playing white.

h: Unbeaten India women face Malaysia in the Asian Champions Trophy semi-final tonight; four Indian women reach Syed Modi quarter-finals
k: India have scored 23 goals and let in just 4 in Bhopal. In Lucknow, Tasnim Mir knocked out the sixth seed.

h: Government reminds Netflix not to show Pakistani content in India, days before its first Pakistani original series
k: Film workers' groups have asked the PM to stop 'Jo Bachay Hain Sang Samait Lo', which premieres globally on 4 December.

h: Ramayana: Part 1 is ₹8 crore short of ₹1,000 crore net in India, and reaches ₹1,777 crore worldwide
k: Its Hindi version has crossed ₹750 crore net, only the third film to do so.

h: 10 lakh Deccan Mahseer, the 'tiger of the river', are released back into Maharashtra's Ujani reservoir
k: The fish had become rare in the Bhima river by the 1990s. A BNHS project is also clearing invasive fish and weeds.

h: Coast Guard and Paradip Port save all 27 crew of a flooding cargo ship off Odisha
k: Water poured into the MV Vishva Uday's engine room about 50 nautical miles out at sea.

h: Mumbai startup TWIN has collected 17.5 tonnes of old clothes, giving rag collectors steady work
k: Free doorstep pickups from 650+ homes now supply 15–20 informal recyclers with sorted fabric.

h: A Bengaluru startup turns waste fabric into reusable birthday decorations, used at 64 parties so far
k: Matter Party rents out bunting and banners stitched from scrap cloth, then takes them back to use again.

h: A 19-year-old student raises ₹22 lakh for a 40-year-old Dharavi school that teaches 560 children
k: Daniel Gupta beat his ₹20 lakh target and now hopes to help the school buy its land.

h: Wild kiwi are living in the hills around New Zealand's capital for the first time in over 150 years
k: More than 250 birds have been moved there, and over 90% of chicks now survive thanks to 5,300 stoat traps.

h: Indigenous women in Bolivia's Andes plant nearly 500,000 native trees to bring back water
k: The Kewiña tree catches mountain fog and sends it into the soil, feeding springs that supply a big city.

h: Nearly 1,000 volunteers farm a school's land for free in Texas, raising $3 million for college scholarships
k: Each harvest from the 640-acre farm in Gruver brings in about $400,000 for local students.

h: 126 acres near Cape Cod's First Encounter Beach are handed back to a Native American land trust
k: The salt marsh is near where Pilgrims and Nauset people clashed in 1620. It will never be built on.

h: A rubber glove filled with warm water saves an endangered peacock-pheasant chick at Chester Zoo
k: Only 15 Malay peacock-pheasants live in European zoos. The chick's mother took it back the next morning.

h: Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy steps down after 11 years as Walmart probe and IPO delays hang over the company
k: Flipkart has confirmed that its group CEO is leaving. Chief product and technology officer Balaji Thiagarajan will run the company until a new CEO is named in the coming weeks.

h: Ajay Devgn sues Maharashtra's food regulator over Vimal elaichi ads, says cardamom isn't banned; Hindi ad has 107 million views
k: Maharashtra told Devgn, Shah Rukh Khan and Tiger Shroff to stop promoting Vimal cardamom, saying the brand is really known for banned pan masala. Devgn has gone to court, and the case could decide how far surrogate ads can go.

h: PhonePe revives its IPO, eyes a March 2027 listing at up to $15 billion valuation, eight months after hitting pause
k: The Walmart-backed payments app has restarted talks with bankers and plans to file updated IPO papers by the end of December, reports say.

h: Reliance Jio launches JioAstro, an AI astrology app, to take on Astrotalk in India's $390 million digital astrology market
k: The app reads your birth chart and lets you chat with an AI 'astrologer' in four languages. Tech Twitter has been quick to mock it.

h: US proposes tariffs of up to 25% on Indian goods over 'excess capacity', or 17% if India signs a trade deal
k: Washington named India among 14 economies it says flood the world with cheap factory goods. India says it has no such excess capacity and wants the issue settled in trade talks.

h: TVS family feud goes to court: Lakshmi Venu sues father Venu Srinivasan in Madras High Court seeking her share of family assets
k: Backed by her mother Mallika Srinivasan, Lakshmi Venu wants the joint family wealth of her father's branch of the TVS group divided, saying talks after her 16 November notice went nowhere.

h: ASCI says 95% of influencer ads it checked had to be changed; Meta accounts for 73% of all ad violations
k: The ad watchdog's half-yearly report finds personal care brands broke influencer rules most often, while illegal betting ads topped the overall list.

h: Boba Bhai pays ₹3 crore to six early employees in an ESOP cash-out, a week after its $18 million Series B
k: The bubble tea chain let its first staff sell a quarter of their vested stock options, about ₹50 lakh each on average, even though it is still loss-making.

h: IT Secretary S Krishnan backs Sarvam AI, says hosting Chinese models on Token Factory doesn't break IndiaAI Mission rules
k: After days of criticism over its sovereign-AI image, Sarvam gets support from the government, which says it sees 'no misuse' of IndiaAI support.

h: Cabinet clears ₹11,000 crore scheme to make tunnel boring machines and excavators in India, and cut reliance on China
k: The plan pays companies extra for making more heavy construction machines at home. The Cabinet also approved ₹2,632 crore to modernise India Post.

h: Constitution Day: Congress holds 'Samvidhan Raksha' marches in every state over voter lists, as BJP runs its own events
k: India marks 77 years since the Constitution was adopted on 26 November 1949. Both big parties are using the day to make their political case.

h: India's pavilion wins the Visitors' Lion at the Venice Art Biennale, on its first return in seven years
k: Visitors voted India's show 'Geographies of Distance: Remembering Home' the best national pavilion. PM Modi called it 'a proud moment'.

h: Houthis claim attack on Saudi Arabia's biggest refinery, Ras Tanura; Brent oil jumps about 3.5%
k: Satellite images showed thick smoke over the site. Saudi Arabia says it shot down four drones, but has not said whether the refinery was hit.

h: Poland plans a no-fly zone over 10 km deep along the Ukraine border, and asks NATO to shoot down Russian missiles over Ukraine
k: Warsaw wants the zone in place by early 2027, after Russian missiles and drones again strayed into Polish airspace this week.

h: Judges in Netanyahu's 6-year corruption trial suggest dropping or settling cases; he says the trial 'must end immediately'
k: The judges said proving the bribery charge faces 'considerable difficulties'. Israel's attorney general says she will consider their suggestions.

h: Hackers break into an unclassified intelligence system shared by the CIA and the US spy chief's office
k: Officials say classified networks were not touched. It is not yet known who did it or whether any data was taken.

h: US senators demand AI curbs after over two dozen OpenAI and Anthropic insiders say their unreleased models may be too risky to release
k: An Axios report says staff at the two leading AI labs worry their newest internal models are hard to control. Four Democratic senators, including Bernie Sanders, now want Congress to act.

h: S&P warns it may cut Nvidia's AA credit rating over board oversight after Jensen Huang's return; shares slide about 4%
k: The rating agency says Huang's exit and quick reinstatement leave open questions about how the world's top AI chipmaker is governed. It will decide within 90 days.

h: 42 US attorneys general move to block bankrupt Character.AI from auctioning chats of 21 million users, including 2.1 million minors
k: The chatbot company's assets, including private chat histories, are set to be auctioned on 1 December. States say the buyer would not have to follow its privacy promises.

h: EU proposes a €50 billion fund to buy stakes in European AI and quantum companies so they stay out of US and Chinese hands
k: The Sovereign Tech Equity Fund comes with a draft Quantum Act that aims to make Europe a quantum leader by 2030.

h: Sensex jumps 1,502 points to 83,938 and Nifty gains 1.85% as foreign buying returns; rupee hits its best level this year
k: Markets won back all of Monday's crash in one session on Wednesday, led by private banks and FMCG stocks, while the rupee rose 69 paise to about 92.16 a dollar.

h: IPO watch: Foodlink F&B opens at ₹181–191, Crystal Crop lists today, and Mahanadi Coalfields debuts Friday with grey-market premium at zero
k: A busy week for new issues: one ₹361 crore IPO opens Thursday, Integris Medtech follows on Friday, and Coal India's arm lists after a lukewarm response.

h: India's women blank Japan 4-0 to win all 5 group games at the Asian Champions Trophy and rise to world No. 4
k: Deepika scored twice as the defending champions finished top of the table in Bhopal. India now face Malaysia in the semi-finals.

h: Gukesh draws Game 2 in just 20 moves with white; World Chess Championship against Sindarov level at 1-1
k: The champion tried the London System, but Sindarov was well prepared and the game ended in a repetition in under two hours. Gukesh has black in Game 3 tonight.

h: India and New Zealand play for the series in Christchurch from 3:30 am IST Friday after the 720-run Wellington draw
k: The second and final Test at Hagley Oval decides the series. New Zealand are without spinner Mitchell Santner and pacer Blair Tickner.

h: Lille hand Bayern Munich their first defeat of the season, 2-1, while Liverpool win 3-0 at Club Brugge
k: An own goal by Aleksandar Pavlović sank a depleted Bayern in France. Alexander Isak scored twice for Liverpool, and Manchester United were held 2-2 in Lisbon.

h: Ramayana: Part 1 passes Pushpa 2 to become India's 4th highest-grossing film, at ₹1,755.6 crore worldwide
k: The Ranbir Kapoor and Yash epic made about ₹9.6 crore net in India on day 21 and now stands at ₹982.55 crore, just short of ₹1,000 crore.

h: O.M: Operation Mole crosses ₹100 crore worldwide in 5 days, Mammootty's first ₹100 crore hit from tickets alone
k: The Dhanush–Mammootty spy drama has made ₹106.25 crore worldwide in six days, per Sacnilk. Mammootty's earlier best was about ₹88 crore.

h: Friday clash: Emraan Hashmi's Gunmaaster G9 takes on Sooraj Barjatya's Yeh Prem Mol Liya on 27 November
k: An action romance and a family drama open on the same day. Early ticket sales are steady, but neither is near a record.

h: Once hunted almost to nothing for fur, Eurasian otters are showing up again in Kashmir's rivers, new studies show
k: Videos, camera traps and field surveys have found the shy river animal back in several streams of the Kashmir Valley.

h: Two Delhi teens turn ordinary classroom fans into air purifiers with a ₹140 filter, now reaching about 20,000 students
k: Krish Aggarwal and Samarth Meattle's balloon-like filter slips over a fan in under a minute and traps fine dust.

h: Shot while capturing Kasab alive on 26/11, retired cop Sanjay Govilkar now helps grieving families in 21 villages
k: Eighteen years after the Mumbai attacks, the officer who took a bullet at Girgaum Chowpatty spends his time helping others through loss and legal trouble.

h: A techie who left the US turns her father's leftover amla into 25+ products, now sold to over 4,000 customers
k: Kalaiselvi's Aruvi Eco Organics in Tamil Nadu uses about 60% of the farm's spare fruit and gives steady jobs to local workers.

h: Children narrate Panchatantra and Mahabharata tales for other kids on a free audio library, with about 700 recordings in 3 months
k: The Vyasa Project lets children practise reading aloud in six languages, and every recording is checked by hand.

h: A dying 9-year-old's wish comes true: a 15,000 sq ft children's museum opens inside a New Orleans hospital
k: Walker's Imaginarium, built only with donations, gives young patients a place to play, dance and even golf between treatments.

h: A 13th-century carved Virgin stolen from a Spanish village church in 1979 is found in the UK and handed back
k: The walnut statue, taken by the famous art thief known as 'Erik the Belgian', was returned by its owner as soon as police explained its history.

h: A Texas mechanic couple give a car to a mum who walked everywhere for 3 years, their 8th free car this year
k: Cathy and Dane Bailey fix up donated cars and give them to people in need through their Autos for Love programme.

h: A 6–12 month drug course reversed a hormone-driven type of high blood pressure for up to 2 years in a small study
k: Nearly a quarter of the 14 patients had normal blood pressure with no pills at all after treatment ended.

h: FSSAI declares a Bisleri water batch from Goa unsafe and clears prosecution; Bisleri says the ban covers just one batch
k: A retest found traces of chemicals called PAHs in one batch of Bisleri bottled water. Bisleri says the batch was made in September 2025 and is no longer on shelves.

h: Nvidia brings back Jensen Huang as CEO 11 days after he quit; shares jump 31% in a day, then slip about 6%
k: Nvidia's board voted unanimously to reinstate its founder after President Trump publicly pushed for his return. Its investigation into the reasons he resigned is still going on.

h: JioStar, the company behind JioHotstar, plans to cut about 150 jobs to control costs, with six months' pay as severance
k: The Reliance–Disney media giant calls it 'portfolio rebalancing'. It is the second big round of job cuts since Viacom18 and Star India merged in 2024.

h: 94% of India's popular apps and websites still use 'dark patterns' to trick users, says a LocalCircles study of 354 platforms
k: Even many platforms that told the government they were 'dark-pattern-free' were found using tricks like hidden charges and forced sign-ups.

h: Bengal will pay jobless graduates ₹2,000 a month from January under the new Bhorsha scheme; cabinet also clears renaming the state 'Paschim Banga'
k: Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari's cabinet replaced the old Yuvasathi scheme and will check about 54 lakh existing beneficiaries by 31 December. The name-change resolution goes to the Assembly on 9 December.

h: A Chennai gelato shop's 'Grown-Up Cerelac' served in baby feeding bottles goes viral and draws a backlash from doctors
k: Crowds lined up at Gelateria Ciacco after influencer posts, but critics called the feeding-bottle gimmick tasteless.

h: Tata Motors will raise car and SUV prices by an average 0.5% from 1 December, including EVs
k: The carmaker says it can no longer absorb rising input costs. Hyundai and Audi have also announced price hikes.

h: Sarvam AI co-founder Pratyush Kumar hits back at critics, saying its Token Factory 'runs on privately-procured GPUs'
k: Critics online accused the government-backed AI startup of using public money to host Chinese models like DeepSeek. Sarvam says that is wrong.

h: Shadowfax buys WeFast's India business and Borzo's tech for about ₹23.3 crore to enter on-demand city deliveries
k: The listed logistics company gets WeFast's network of over 32,000 delivery partners as it goes after small shops and person-to-person deliveries.

h: Hotel brand Bloom raises $75 million led by Kedaara Capital; AI startup AidenAI raises $32 million
k: Two of the week's biggest rounds: Bloom wants to grow to 12,000 rooms, while AidenAI plans to train 1,000+ AI engineers in Hyderabad.

h: Luggage brand Mokobara launches Goose Emergency, a handbag label that started as a joke Instagram page
k: It is Mokobara's first move into fashion, with a loud, 'maximalist' look that is the opposite of its plain suitcases.

h: From 1 December: SBI credit cards charge 1% on big fuel and travel spends, while LPG and fuel prices face their monthly review
k: Fuel spends above ₹50,000 in a billing cycle will attract a 1% fee on the whole amount. Here is what changes, and what might, as December begins.

h: India announces a ₹15,000 crore package for Nepal and opens Kandla and Paradip ports to it as Modi and Balendra Shah sign 8 agreements
k: Nepal PM Balendra Shah's first state visit ended on 23 November with a new Ayodhya–Janakpur train, a border bridge and deals on space, health and training.

h: S&P trims India's FY28 growth forecast to 7% and expects the RBI to raise rates again in December
k: With retail inflation at 6.1% in October, above the RBI's comfort band, S&P sees the repo rate climbing to 6% by March 2027 — which would mean costlier loans.

h: BJP and Akali Dal reunite for the 2027 Punjab election, six years after splitting over the farm laws
k: Amit Shah, BJP president Nitin Nabin and Sukhbir Badal announced the tie-up in Delhi on 24 November; seat-sharing is still being worked out.

h: Ukraine says 7 sea drones sank Russian warship Merkury at Libya's Benghazi naval base, taking the war to North Africa
k: Satellite images show the corvette capsized; a Russian cargo ship was also hit. Moscow warns of 'painful' consequences.

h: COP31 in Antalya ends with no climate deal after record overtime, as countries split over moving away from fossil fuels
k: The longest UN climate summit ever broke up on 22 November without its main text — the first such collapse since Copenhagen in 2009.

h: Houthis hit Riyadh's tallest tower, the PIF headquarters, for the second time in a week; 11 people injured
k: Saudi civil defence reported the injuries on 24 November. The Saudi-led coalition says a drone was used and vows a 'decisive' response.

h: OpenAI brings GPT-6.2 Sol to ChatGPT's main chat for paying users; it passes hard safety tests 91–94% of the time, up from about 78%
k: The chat-tuned model is better at reading small details in photos and searching the web, says OpenAI. Free and Go users don't get it.

h: Anthropic shares close below their $83 IPO price, falling 6.5% to about $81.91, just days after a record debut
k: The Claude maker opened at $111.50 on its first day of trading last Thursday, but has fallen steadily since as tech shares cooled.

h: Oregon and Virginia become the first 2 US states to sue SpaceX over Grok's sexual deepfakes
k: The states say Elon Musk's company, which now owns xAI and X, failed to stop its AI from making harmful fake images, including of children, while marketing it as safe.

h: Sensex crashes 1,484 points to 82,436 and Nifty falls to 25,350, its biggest one-day drop in about five months
k: Investors cashed in after a four-week rally, with bank and metal shares hit hardest. Markets were shut on Tuesday for Guru Nanak Jayanti and reopen today.

h: IPO watch: Mahanadi Coalfields' ₹8,981 crore IPO scrapes through at 1.52 times; SEBI tells market players to stop sharing 'GMP'
k: Big institutions saved Coal India's subsidiary's IPO as retail buyers stayed away, while SEBI warned that grey market premiums are no guide to listing gains.

h: India's record 720 isn't enough: Mitchell and Phillips bat out the last day as New Zealand draw the Wellington Test
k: India needed eight wickets on the last day but took only three on a flat Basin Reserve pitch. The series is level 0-0 going into Christchurch on Friday.

h: Gukesh starts his World Chess Championship defence with a 38-move draw against Sindarov in Geneva
k: The 14-game, $2.5 million match is level at 0.5–0.5. Game 2 is today at 7:30 pm IST, with Gukesh playing White.

h: Deepika's 14-minute hat-trick powers India's women to a record 6-2 win over China at the Asian Champions Trophy
k: It is India's biggest win over China in the tournament's history and their fourth win in four games in Bhopal. They face Japan tonight.

h: Mbappé scores twice as Real Madrid hit PSV for 5 to stay perfect on 15 points; Arsenal held 1-1 by Dortmund
k: On Champions League matchday 5, Manchester City also drew 2-2 with Napoli and Aston Villa lost 1-0 at Galatasaray.

h: Ramayana: Part 1 crosses ₹1,700 crore worldwide and nears ₹1,000 crore net in India after a Guru Nanak Jayanti boost
k: The film earned ₹17.5 crore on its third Tuesday, up about 38% on Monday thanks to the holiday, per Sacnilk. It is now within touching distance of Pushpa 2's lifetime total.

h: Panchayat Season 5 trailer is out: Banrakas's wife is Phulera's new Pradhan, and the show returns on Prime Video on 3 December
k: Kranti Devi has beaten Manju Devi in the village election, and her husband Banrakas is ready to run things his way.

h: OTT this week: Drishyam 3 on Netflix on 27 November, plus Blade Runner 2099 and Spider-Man: Brand New Day
k: Ajay Devgn's hit thriller lands on streaming on Friday, after its theatrical run began on 2 October.

h: IIT Roorkee scientists create a brand-new spring that doubles summer drinking water for a Tehri village, to 1,000 litres a day
k: By mapping the rocks under a Himalayan hillside, researchers found where groundwater was trapped and opened a path for it to reach Unchaun village.

h: Women of an Uttarakhand village bring 28 acres of bare forest back to life, with no forest fire there in over 20 years
k: Led by 75-year-old Bhagirathi Devi, known as 'Van Amma', the women of Manar in Champawat turned an overgrazed hillside into a healthy oak forest that the forest department now holds up as a fire-prevention model.

h: A Hyderabad paediatrician helps cut a rare-disease drug's cost from up to ₹9 crore a year to about ₹2.5 lakh; seven children get a free year of treatment
k: Dr Sivaranjani Santosh refused to give up after drug makers ignored her, and with patient advocates found an affordable source of tiratricol.

h: A 26-year-old pays Bhavani weavers up to 35% extra to keep Tamil Nadu's 300-year-old Jamakkalam craft alive
k: Varsha Sivakumar's House of Jamakkalam works with 30–35 weavers and is finding new buyers, from Instagram to Sri Lankan Tamil weddings.

h: Surat schoolboy's AI tool to forecast groundwater wins a national contest of over 6,100 projects
k: Dheyay Shah's JALAAKAR uses borewell records, rainfall and soil data to estimate how much water lies under each taluka.

h: Releasing Wolbachia mosquitoes cut dengue by 68.5% in a Brazilian city during the country's worst outbreak on record
k: A randomised trial in Belo Horizonte found that mosquitoes carrying a harmless bacterium also reduced chikungunya by 73%.

h: 47,473 acres of Alaskan islands where Pacific walrus rest are now protected for good
k: After a decade of work, a conservation easement near Point Lay shields North America's largest walrus haul-out from disturbance and development.

h: A school on Micronesia's Yap island lets families pay fees in coconuts, so no child is priced out
k: The coconuts are pressed into virgin coconut oil, reviving an island industry that died out two decades ago, with profits going to local charity.

h: After a 7-hour night search, a volunteer finds a missing 2-year-old safe under a desert bush 2 miles from home
k: Jay Stewart heard a small voice answering his calls near Eloy, Arizona, and kept the shivering girl warm until help came.

h: Indian startup GG Technologies sues Apple for ₹1,500 crore, saying the iPhone's NameDrop copies its patented contact-sharing tech
k: The maker of the StayTouch app has gone to the Bombay High Court and wants NameDrop switched off in India.

h: Old Monk maker Mohan Meakin's revenue falls 64% to ₹288 crore after FSSAI says three variants can't be sold as 'rum'
k: India's most nostalgic rum brand is in a labelling fight with the food regulator, and it is showing up hard in the numbers.

h: An Anthropic mathematician says he and Claude have proved the Riemann Hypothesis, a 167-year-old maths problem with a $1 million prize; Lean experts back the proof
k: The proof is written entirely in computer-checked code. Experts who build the checking software say they are confident it is correct, but no traditional peer review has happened yet.

h: ₹10 jeera soda Lahori Zeera, started by three cousins in Punjab, expects about ₹1,112 crore in revenue as desi drinks eat into Coke and Pepsi
k: A cheap, spicy, very Indian fizzy drink has become one of the biggest challenger brands in the soft-drinks aisle.

h: Deepinder Goyal shares a paper suggesting gravity may help cause ageing, calling it 'a hypothesis' as doctors keep questioning his Temple device
k: The Eternal founder says only experiments can prove the idea right or wrong, and has invited researchers to try to disprove it.

h: Hair-care brand Traya's revenue jumps 73% to ₹585 crore in FY26, but its loss widens 23% to ₹29 crore
k: The D2C brand is growing fast and spending heavily, with Rajkummar Rao fronting its latest campaign.

h: Shah Rukh and Aryan Khan's D'YAVOL X enters physical stores for the first time with a Golden Goose sneaker collab, on sale from 24 November
k: The luxury streetwear label is going from online drops to real shelves, with pieces set to appear in SRK's film King.

h: Maharashtra warns influencers of fines up to ₹10 lakh for misleading protein and supplement claims
k: A new state order bans ads that pitch supplements as cures, and gyms selling them now need a food-safety licence.

h: Bewakoof co-founder Prabhkiran Singh launches Save8, an AI tool that finds the cheapest price across Amazon, Flipkart, Blinkit and Zepto
k: Paste a product link and it checks prices, coupons, cashback and bank offers across more than 1,000 online stores.

h: Tata's Voltas and Atomberg sign a joint venture to make AC compressors in India, each committing up to ₹100 crore
k: Voltas takes 50% of the venture and will control its board, making it a Voltas subsidiary.

h: EPFO lets retirees take their PF as a monthly payout and cuts the balance that must stay in the account from 25% to 10%
k: A new Systematic Withdrawal Plan lets the rest of your money keep earning EPF interest.

h: Nepal PM Balendra Shah begins his first state visit to India; talks with PM Modi on Monday will focus on flood rebuilding, trade and energy
k: The 36-year-old leader's two-day trip is his first bilateral visit since Nepal's March election.

h: India's core sector output grows 10.9% in October, led by iron ore, coal and electricity
k: Eight key industries grew at their fastest pace on the new series, though a weak base last year helped.

h: PM Modi opens the six-lane Nitish Setu over the Ganga and launches ₹34,470 crore of projects in Bihar
k: The cable-stayed Dargah–Bidupur bridge links the Patna and Vaishali sides of the river.

h: COP31 talks run into Sunday as summit president Murat Kurum says a final climate deal is close
k: A new text tries to answer complaints that an earlier draft dropped all mention of moving away from fossil fuels.

h: Iran's missile and drone attack hits an industrial site in Bahrain; Tehran says it was aiming at US radars
k: Bahrain says no one was hurt and has asked the UN Security Council to act.

h: Drones set a sanctioned Russian military-linked cargo ship on fire in the Gulf of Finland; it drifts into Finnish waters
k: The Sparta II was sailing from St Petersburg to Kaliningrad when it was hit near Estonia.

h: Denmark expels Russia's defence attaché over an alleged plot to kill Ukrainian rapper Kyivstoner
k: Copenhagen will also stop issuing non-essential visas to Russians and wants the EU to follow.

h: Devin maker Cognition is in talks to raise money at a $75 billion valuation, and Databricks at $225 billion
k: Investors are still betting big on AI companies with fast-growing revenue, even after this week's chip-stock rout.

h: Amazon is close to buying AI startup Decart for up to about $7.5 billion, the Financial Times reports
k: Decart makes AI models run more efficiently, and was an early user of Amazon's own Trainium3 chips.

h: ChatGPT and OpenAI's API go down for about 3.5 hours on Saturday, with up to 75% of requests failing
k: A database fault during planned maintenance knocked out logins, chats and voice for millions — in India it hit during the evening.

h: IPO week ahead: Foodlink F&B and Integris Medtech open, while Mahanadi Coalfields' ₹8,981 crore IPO closes on Monday
k: Coal India's subsidiary still needs strong bids on its last day after a slow start.

h: Sensex gains 2,327 points this week and Nifty rises 2.6% for a fourth straight weekly gain, as bank stocks lead
k: India held up while Asia and the Nasdaq slumped on AI worries, helped by record foreign buying.

h: Gold has its worst week since March, sliding about 9% globally; 24-carat in India falls to about ₹1.26 lakh per 10 grams
k: A firm dollar and bets on a US rate hike knocked precious metals, and silver fell even harder.

h: India declare at 720 for 9 in Wellington, the highest total ever at the Basin Reserve, as Rishabh Pant hits 128
k: Six Indian batters passed 50, giving India a lead of 352 over New Zealand on day four of the first Test.

h: Lakshya Sen and Satwik–Chirag both lose in the Hong Kong Open semi-finals, ending India's run
k: Lakshya's 13-match winning streak ends against Denmark's Anders Antonsen.

h: India's women beat South Korea 2-1 at the Asian Champions Trophy in Bhopal for their second straight win
k: Mumtaz Khan and Sunelita Toppo scored as the defending champions stayed unbeaten at home.

h: Leeds thrash Chelsea 4-1 for their first win at Stamford Bridge since 1999; leaders Arsenal draw 2-2 at Newcastle
k: Noah Okafor scored twice as Leeds jumped above Chelsea into sixth in the Premier League.

h: Ramayana: Part 1 crosses ₹900 crore net in India on day 17, joining only Pushpa 2 and Dhurandhar 2
k: Saturday's collection jumped 74% from Friday, taking the worldwide gross past ₹1,616 crore.

h: Dhanush and Mammootty's O.M: Operation Mole gives Dhanush his biggest opening, about ₹31.5 crore worldwide on day one
k: The spy drama opened strongly in Tamil Nadu and the Telugu states, though reviews are mixed.

h: India's solar power capacity crosses 174.5 GW, up 34% in a year
k: The country added about 38.7 GW of solar between January and October alone.

h: India's cheetah count reaches 62 after a Botswana-born cheetah gives birth to four cubs in the wild at Kuno
k: It is the first time a cheetah brought from Botswana has given birth in India.

h: India's TB deaths have fallen 38% since 2015, faster than the world average, WHO says
k: There is still a long way to go, but the trend is moving the right way.

h: A single CRISPR infusion cut 'bad' cholesterol by about half for a year in a first human trial
k: The one-time gene-editing treatment switches off a liver gene linked to high cholesterol.

h: Scientists read a humpback whale's whole genome from its breath, caught by a drone
k: No darts, no biopsies — just a drone carrying petri dishes through a whale's spout.

h: An Ethiopian water mouse last seen in 1927 is found alive, almost a century later
k: A researcher caught one with peanut butter as bait, and his team has since found two more.

h: Lake Baikal, which holds a fifth of the world's surface fresh water, is refilling at its fastest rate in 343 years
k: Tree rings show river inflows into the Siberian lake have bounced back sharply since 2017.

h: China's 19-seat electric plane, the COMAC CE-25A, makes its first flight with a crew on board
k: Powered by 10 electric fans, it is designed for short 400 km hops with zero fuel burnt.

h: A mosque in Jordan turns the water used for prayer-washing into a green garden
k: In one of the world's driest countries, 35+ mosques now reuse their ablution water.

h: Airtel is India's most valuable brand at $43.2 billion in Kantar BrandZ 2026; Blinkit enters at No. 27 and Meesho grows fastest, up 64%
k: Kantar's yearly list of India's 100 most valuable brands is out. Telecom and banks still rule the top, but quick commerce and value shopping are climbing fast.

h: Supreme Court clears bike taxis in Karnataka, saying it is 'better to regulate it than ban it' — a big win for Rapido, Uber and Ola
k: The top court dismissed Karnataka's appeal, ending a ban that shut bike taxis in Bengaluru and the rest of the state in June 2025.

h: Google's new Gemini ads in India mock a fictional 'Chatty AI' that keeps asking users to pay — days after ChatGPT's Raghu ad
k: India's AI ad war is heating up. Three new Gemini films show a rival assistant hitting users with paywalls and limits in the middle of their day.

h: Nvidia shares crash 14% and lose about $491 billion in a day after reports of an SEC accounting probe; the Nasdaq falls 5.3%
k: It was Nvidia's worst day since the DeepSeek scare, and it dragged the whole AI trade down with it.

h: Nike plans to triple its India business by 2031, with a full cricket shoe range and a running shoe built for Indian runners
k: India is one of the bright spots in Nike's new turnaround plan, even as the company warns that its global sales will shrink next year.

h: Flipkart's Big Billion Days timing knocks about 5 points off Walmart International's growth; the unit still grows 7% to $35.9 billion
k: Because this year's sale fell in a different quarter, Walmart's Indian business showed up weaker than usual in its latest results.

h: Shark Tank India Season 6 opens a 'Content Creators Special': influencers can now pitch their brands to the Sharks
k: "Don't just post your ideas. Pitch them!" says the new call for entries on Sony LIV.

h: Eggoz grows revenue from about ₹75 crore to ₹180 crore in three years by selling branded eggs on quick commerce apps
k: Quick commerce now brings in 85–90% of its volume, in a market where most eggs are still sold loose at the kirana.

h: Fireside Ventures, early backer of boAt and Mamaearth, faces a leadership shake-up as co-founder Vinay Singh leaves
k: Founder Kanwaljit Singh has also signalled he will step back from daily work, Inc42 reports, raising the question of who runs the ₹5,300 crore fund next.

h: Cyclone Akvan crosses Odisha near Gopalpur with 70–80 kmph winds; no deaths reported after 3.72 lakh people were moved to safety
k: The storm weakened before landfall and brought very heavy rain to Ganjam, but Odisha says it caused no major damage.

h: India's forex reserves fall $14.2 billion in a week to $705.3 billion, a three-month low, even as the rupee hits a seven-month high
k: RBI data shows the drop came mostly from revaluation, as the value of gold and foreign assets changed.

h: US court sentences Indian national Nikhil Gupta to 235 months in prison over the foiled plot to kill Gurpatwant Singh Pannun
k: Gupta had pleaded guilty earlier this year. He apologised in court.

h: Election Commission postpones West Bengal's voter-list revision that was due to start on 23 November; new dates to come later
k: The state's Chief Electoral Officer cited "some unavoidable circumstances" and gave no other reason.

h: India unveils its first home-grown bird flu vaccine for chickens; one dose protects for about six months
k: The H5N1 vaccine was developed by ICAR's high-security animal disease lab in Bhopal.

h: Estonia will close its road border with Russia from 1 December for at least six months; Moscow calls it a 'new Iron Curtain'
k: Tallinn blames Russia for an attempted arson attack on an Estonian drone maker. The Kremlin denies it.

h: Russian missiles and a drone land in Poland during a massive strike on Ukraine; NATO calls it a 'grave violation'
k: No one was hurt in Poland, but PM Donald Tusk said it looked like "an intentional provocation".

h: Saudi-led coalition strikes Yemen's Hodeidah port after the Houthi hit on Riyadh's PIF tower; Houthis threaten Red Sea ports
k: The tit-for-tat raises fears for shipping and for an aid lifeline that millions of Yemenis depend on.

h: COP31 climate talks in Antalya run into overtime after a draft deal drops all mention of moving away from fossil fuels
k: A third draft is due on Saturday morning, as many countries push back against the weaker text.

h: Trump threatens a 'tremendous tax' on US companies that build data centres abroad, naming Google's plans in Finland
k: He gave no rate, timeline or legal route, and said he had not yet told his own officials.

h: European Commission confirms a cyberattack that used AI tools; payroll and medical claims systems were down for over 10 days
k: The first signs of the attack were spotted on 22 October.

h: CrowdStrike is in talks to buy Zscaler, which would be the biggest cybersecurity deal ever; Zscaler shares jump 18%
k: Zscaler is worth about $32 billion, making this bigger than Google's purchase of Wiz.

h: Apple is building its own AI agent that can use your Mac — browse, switch apps and write code — Bloomberg spots in a job listing
k: A launch could come as soon as the end of next year, but the work is in early stages.

h: Sensex jumps 898 points to 83,920 and Nifty ends at 25,801, a nine-month high, as foreign funds pour a record $12.2 billion into India this month
k: Banks led the rally, with Nifty Bank up 2.49% and IndusInd Bank up 8.6%.

h: IPO watch: Crystal Crop Protection's ₹455 crore IPO is subscribed about 17 times, while Mahanadi Coalfields is under half-filled after two days
k: Two very different receptions: a small agrochemicals issue is oversubscribed, while Coal India's big sale is still waiting for buyers.

h: KL Rahul hits his first Test century in New Zealand as India close in on the hosts' 368 in Wellington
k: Rahul and Devdutt Padikkal added 167 for the second wicket on day three of the first Test.

h: Lakshya Sen reaches the Hong Kong Open semi-finals with his 13th straight win; Satwik–Chirag are through too
k: Sen beat eighth seed Loh Kean Yew in three games and now faces Anders Antonsen.

h: Bengaluru FC go top of the ISL with a 2-0 win over Mumbai City in Sunil Chhetri's 200th ISL match
k: In Kolkata, East Bengal snatched a late 2-2 draw against SC Delhi.

h: GTA VI makes $3.79 billion on day one, the biggest launch in entertainment history, says Take-Two
k: The game had already sold 32.5 million copies before it even came out.

h: Ramayana: Part 1 earns ₹16.3 crore on day 16 and reaches ₹1,574.6 crore worldwide, closing in on Pushpa 2
k: The film has now made ₹880 crore net in India, according to Sacnilk's early estimates.

h: Voyager 1 becomes the first spacecraft ever to be one light-day from Earth, and the Empire State Building lights up gold for it
k: Launched in 1977, the little probe is still talking to us — its messages now take a full day to arrive.

h: AIIMS Delhi doctors repair an unborn baby's spine inside the womb, India's first open foetal surgery of its kind
k: The six-hour operation at 25 weeks of pregnancy was done for free under a government scheme.

h: An Assam father and daughter turn rhino and elephant dung into notebooks, giving villagers a reason to protect wildlife
k: Elrhino's paper is made from washed and boiled dung mixed with recycled fibres.

h: Young guardians of Tamil Nadu's Tamiraparani river win the $15,000 Iris Prize for protecting it
k: The team monitors a 30-km stretch of a river that feeds nearly 40,000 hectares of farmland.

h: A 17-year-old in Gurugram builds an AI tool that makes bank statements and textbooks readable for blind people
k: Yash Bhatnagar's Visionably fixes PDFs so screen readers can read them aloud.

h: IIT Madras-incubated EarthFokus has helped 130+ buildings save over 5 billion litres of water using sensors and AI
k: The Chennai startup finds hidden leaks and cuts tap flow to a fraction of normal.

h: WHO praises India and Bangladesh for banning paraquat, a deadly weedkiller linked to thousands of suicides
k: The two countries join more than 70 others that have already banned it.

h: Eritrea beats trachoma, the world's leading infectious cause of blindness, the WHO confirms
k: It is the 34th country to do so, and the 11th in Africa.

h: Native oysters are breeding in Scotland's Dornoch Firth for the first time in over 100 years
k: A restoration project that began with 300 oysters in 2017 now has wild-born babies.

h: A cancer vaccine cuts the risk of death by 41% for leukaemia patients in a late-stage trial
k: Patients on the vaccine lived a median of 24 months, against 14.7 months on standard care.

h: Airbnb and Dharma recreate K3G's Raichand house in Mumbai for 25 years of the film; 180 fans can visit free from 1–6 December
k: Airbnb is turning the most famous mansion in Hindi cinema into a free two-hour experience. Bookings open on 23 November at noon.

h: Anthropic opens at $111.50 on Nasdaq and closes at $97.17, 17% above its IPO price, after the biggest IPO ever at $81.3 billion
k: The Claude maker's stock jumped as much as 34% in its first trade under the ticker 'ANT' before giving back some of the gain on a weak day for tech stocks.

h: Sarvam faces backlash for selling DeepSeek and other Chinese AI models on its new Token Factory; it says no subsidy was used
k: India's best-known 'sovereign AI' startup launched a platform to run AI models on its GPUs in India. Critics noticed most of the catalogue is Chinese.

h: McDonald's brings back Home Alone's Kevin, now grown up, locked inside a McDonald's for its global holiday ad
k: Macaulay Culkin returns as Kevin McCallister in a 60-second film where he runs the drive-thru and builds a 'Big McCallister'. A Home Alone Meal arrives on 24 November.

h: Paytm closes 8.5% lower and MobiKwik and Pine Labs fall up to 7% on reports that the UPI merchant fee may wait until after 2027 polls
k: A planned 0.4% fee on some big UPI payments to merchants was meant to start in October. Now it could slip again, hurting the payment companies counting on it.

h: Cyclone Akvan weakens before landfall near Gopalpur today; Odisha moves over 3 lakh people and 1,317 evacuated women give birth in shelters
k: The storm is crossing the north Andhra–south Odisha coast this morning with winds of 70–80 km/h, gusting to 90 km/h.

h: Nitin Gadkari asks states to allow private bikes as app taxis, saying 15–20 crore people could benefit
k: Only a few states have adopted the Centre's aggregator rules that permit bike taxis, and some, like Karnataka, are cracking down.

h: India and Japan agree to boost defence manufacturing, AI and cyber cooperation at their 2+2 talks in Tokyo
k: Rajnath Singh and S Jaishankar met Japan's defence and foreign ministers for the fourth round of the dialogue.

h: UN's top court rules 9–6 that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya, the first time it has found a state guilty of genocide
k: The International Court of Justice ordered Myanmar to prosecute those responsible and allow displaced Rohingya to return safely.

h: Trump, Xi and Putin end their first three-way summit with a 'nuclear war must never be fought' statement but no concrete deals
k: The Shenzhen meeting on the sidelines of APEC was historic, but most analysts say it changed little on Ukraine or Iran.

h: A Houthi missile attack damages Saudi wealth fund PIF's tower, the tallest in Riyadh; no injuries reported
k: It is the second strike on Riyadh's financial district this month, after an Aramco building was hit on 8 November.

h: Denmark's parliament approves a security deal with Greenland and the US 109–0, hoping to end the row over Trump's Greenland threats
k: The pact lets the US expand its military presence on the island, but only NATO members can set up bases there.

h: Cashify turns profitable with ₹6.49 crore in FY26 as revenue from buying and reselling used phones jumps 50% to ₹1,641 crore
k: The Gurugram recommerce company swung from a ₹10.56 crore loss a year earlier.

h: Razorpay may file updated IPO papers as early as next week and list by February 2027 at about a $5 billion valuation
k: The ₹6,000 crore IPO would value the payments firm about a third below its 2021 private valuation, Bloomberg reports.

h: PhysicsWallah will start a digital university in Punjab offering 16 courses like BCA, B.Com and MBA, with admissions from July 2027
k: The listed edtech also set a target of ₹9,000–10,000 crore revenue by FY30 at its first investor day.

h: Paytm will invest up to ₹200 crore in Singapore's Funding Societies group, starting with a 19.1% stake in payments firm CardUp
k: It is part of Paytm's 'partner operated' plan to grow abroad without spending heavily on its own teams.

h: AI agent-testing startup Disseqt AI raises $8 million, with Rahul Dravid among its angel investors
k: Founded in late 2025, the Ireland-headquartered startup has its engineering team in Bengaluru.

h: U.S. Polo Assn. targets ₹4,000 crore of sales in India this year; India is now its fastest-growing market
k: India already makes up about 20% of the brand's global sales, through its partnership with Arvind Fashions.

h: Ahmedabad's NEPRA raises ₹110 crore to triple its plastic recycling to 18,000 tonnes a year
k: London-based PIDG led the round, its first equity bet on waste and recycling in Asia.

h: Meta's Muse AI assistant could read encrypted Signal messages on Android and Mac in Reuters tests; it was blocked on iPhone
k: Muse did not break Signal's encryption. It read message previews through phone permissions users granted during setup.

h: Intuit sells Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for about $3.68 billion, five years after buying it for about $12 billion
k: Intuit will use the cash to buy back its own shares once the deal closes in early 2027.

h: Lenovo's quarterly revenue hits a record $30.2 billion as AI sales jump 79% to $10.8 billion
k: AI now makes up 36% of the PC maker's revenue, and its AI server sales more than quadrupled.

h: Salesforce starts a fresh round of layoffs; India employees say they've been put on garden leave until February
k: The company has not confirmed how many people are affected. Posts on Blind describe packages worth about 21 weeks of pay in India.

h: Sensex jumps 990 points to 83,022 and Nifty reclaims 25,500 as Maruti leads a 4.4% rally in auto stocks
k: Foreign investors have bought a record $11.28 billion of Indian shares so far in November, after two years of heavy selling.

h: Mahanadi Coalfields' IPO is subscribed 0.38 times on day one; big institutions bid 1.26 times their share, retail just 0.14 times
k: The Coal India arm's issue, priced at ₹129–136 a share, stays open until 23 November.

h: Nicholls and Phillips hit centuries as New Zealand recover from 70 for 5 to 317 for 6 against India in Wellington
k: Their 216-run stand took the game away from India on day two of the first Test, after Bumrah's early burst.

h: India's women come from behind to beat Malaysia 4–1 at the Asian Champions Trophy in Bhopal
k: The defending champions trailed after 19 minutes but scored four times, with captain Salima Tete among the scorers.

h: Lakshya Sen qualifies for the BWF World Tour Finals in Hangzhou, five years after his semi-final debut
k: He edged Japan's Koki Watanabe by just 560 points in the race, after Kidambi Srikanth knocked Watanabe out in Hong Kong.

h: GTA 6 breaks the all-time streaming record with 7.9 million people watching live at once, within three hours of launch
k: That is more than four times the old record for a game launch, set by Valorant's beta in 2020.

h: Ramayana: Part 1 earns ₹19.35 crore on day 15; its worldwide total crosses ₹1,547 crore
k: The Ranbir Kapoor–Yash epic's Hindi version alone has now passed ₹650 crore net in India.

h: Varuvaaiy becomes the first Tamil song ever nominated for a Grammy, a Subramania Bharati poem set to music
k: Chennai composer Devan Ekambaram and singer Susha are up for Best Global Music Performance against Rosalía, Shakira and Burna Boy.

h: She went upstairs to complain about the noise and found an 87-year-old with Parkinson's living alone; strangers have now given over $109,000
k: Heidi Widmer's videos about her neighbour Carole in Los Angeles have been watched nearly 30 million times.

h: Students are breeding a rare, much-poached succulent that grows only near their California campus, to bring it back to the wild
k: Santa Clara University scientists also want to flood nurseries with legal plants so poaching stops paying.

h: An engineer's Sunday clean-ups have pulled over 1.2 lakh kg of waste out of Moradabad's Ramganga river
k: More than 5,000 volunteers have joined Kapil Kumar's 218-plus drives since 2018.

h: A pocket-sized ECG built in Dehradun has reached over 20,000 villages, giving heart reports in about two minutes
k: Sunfox's Spandan plugs into a smartphone and needs no internet or extra battery.

h: A student builds a phone app that spots fake malaria tablets from a photo, correctly identifying 94% of real ones in trials
k: Falsified antimalarial drugs are linked to an estimated 267,000 deaths a year.

h: Tusk Conservation Awards honour Africans who cut poaching, beat bottom trawlers in court and brought back black rhinos
k: This year's winners come from Kenya and Mozambique.

h: Blinkit delivers GTA 6 in 11 cities at ₹5,999, the same price as the PlayStation Store, as the game finally launches
k: Eternal's quick-commerce app began dropping boxed PS5 download codes for GTA 6 a day before the global release. 'It took 13 years,' says CEO Albinder Dhindsa.

h: Anthropic prices its IPO at $83 a share, above its range, raising $81.3 billion; trading on Nasdaq as 'ANT' starts today
k: The Claude maker sold about 980 million shares, more than planned, valuing it at roughly $1.5 trillion on a fully diluted basis.

h: Boba Bhai raises $18 million to grow from 120 to as many as 300 outlets; its revenue jumped 145% to about ₹70 crore in FY26
k: The bubble tea chain, founded in 2023, plans to open in Kolkata, Ahmedabad and Chandigarh within three to six months.

h: The 'Dhoni discount': CSK's sponsorship value could fall 10–15% after his IPL exit, say marketers, as 17 brands post farewell tributes
k: From Zomato to Netflix, brands lined up to say goodbye to MS Dhoni, while ad experts debate what Chennai Super Kings loses without him on the field.

h: Cyclone Akvan turns very severe ahead of Friday's landfall; Odisha moves about 50,000 people and Andhra puts 7 districts on red alert
k: The storm's track has shifted north, and landfall is now expected between Narsapur in Andhra Pradesh and Puri in Odisha around noon on 20 November.

h: GTA 6 is finally out on PS5 and Xbox after a 13-year wait; pre-orders topped $1 billion, Sensor Tower estimates
k: Rockstar's game went live at midnight local time around the world, starting in New Zealand. It is not on PC yet.

h: Coal India's Mahanadi Coalfields opens its ₹8,981 crore IPO today at ₹129–136 a share; one lot costs ₹14,960
k: It is a pure offer for sale: Coal India is selling about 10% of MCL, so the company itself gets no money. Crystal Crop's ₹455 crore IPO also closes on Friday.

h: Value fashion chain Style Union raises ₹485 crore to take on Zudio and Trends beyond south India
k: Founded in 2022 by Ekta Biyani, the brand has grown from 41 stores and ₹123 crore revenue to 200 stores and over ₹1,150 crore.

h: Policybazaar co-founder Alok Bansal will step down as PB Fintech's executive vice-chairman after 18 years
k: He will stay on the board as a non-executive director from April 2027. CEO Yashish Dahiya says Bansal first wanted to step back five years ago.

h: Trump, Xi and Putin meet in Shenzhen today for their first three-way talks, with nuclear arms and the Iran war on the agenda
k: Xi broke with protocol to greet Trump on the tarmac at the APEC summit. Few expect a concrete deal.

h: Iran fires drones at a US air base in Kuwait, its first attack on Kuwait since September, after a US strike on Qeshm Island
k: Kuwait says its air defences stopped the drones and calls the attacks 'criminal'. Qatar is holding fresh talks with Iran.

h: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon at $3 per million input tokens, its fourth new Gemini model in a month
k: Neon is live for paid AI Pro and Ultra subscribers and on the API, priced at twice the cheaper Gemini 4 Hydrogen.

h: Egg brand Henfruit raises $15 million, its first outside money in 12 years, and aims for ₹350 crore revenue this year
k: The bootstrapped brand processes over 4 crore eggs a month and publishes its daily lab test reports.

h: Bumrah strikes on the third ball of his comeback Test as India reduce New Zealand to 95 for 5 in Wellington
k: India chose to bowl first at the Basin Reserve, and debutant Anshul Kamboj also struck early.

h: CoinDCX says a breach at its notifications vendor exposed some users' names, emails and bank names; it says funds are safe
k: The crypto exchange blamed two incidents in October at Plotline, the company that sends its in-app messages.

h: DeepMind spin-off Isomorphic Labs raises $5 billion to design drugs with AI; vision-implant maker Science Corp raises $400 million
k: Investors put more than $6.6 billion into nine startups on Wednesday, led by two big bets on AI and health.

h: Modi proposes free e-visas for tourists from ASEAN countries, one of nine ideas he put forward at the India–ASEAN summit in Manila
k: Travellers would still apply online, but the fee would be waived. No start date has been announced.

h: Sensex falls 500 points to 82,032 and Nifty slips to 25,228 as profit-taking hits metal and consumer durables stocks
k: Both indices lost about 0.6% after two days of gains, and mid-caps fell harder.

h: Bengaluru's Humyn Labs raises $47 million to record everyday human work for training robots
k: Started this year by ex-Nazara CEO Manish Agarwal and Ishank Gupta, it says it already has over $50 million in annual revenue.

h: Israel's parliament elects Matan Kahana as speaker by 66–52, a setback for Netanyahu as rival Gadi Eisenkot tries to form a government
k: Control of the speaker's chair gives the opposition a say over the parliamentary agenda.

h: Palo Alto Networks buys AI startup Applied Compute for $4.5 billion in stock
k: Applied Compute helps companies train and run their own AI models; the cybersecurity giant wants security built in from the start.

h: Ola Electric hands scooter sales to dealers, targeting 450 stores by December and over 700 by March 2027
k: The company stopped taking orders at its own showrooms on 1 November, calling the shift a 'reset' to fix slow service.

h: Ribbit Capital sells ₹1,905 crore of Groww shares at ₹219 each; its total take from Groww reaches about ₹7,871 crore
k: Kotak MF, BlackRock, Fidelity, Morgan Stanley and Norges Bank were among the buyers of the roughly 1.4% stake.

h: Women's Asian Champions Trophy starts in Bhopal tonight: defending champions India face Malaysia at 7 pm, with free entry
k: It is India's first tournament since winning gold at the Asian Games in Japan last month.

h: Ramayana: Part 1 reaches ₹844 crore net in India in 14 days, adding ₹23.2 crore on its second Wednesday
k: Worldwide earnings are now around ₹1,500 crore, according to trade trackers.

h: Microsoft Ignite: Copilot gets 'Autopilot' agents that keep working on recurring tasks without a prompt at every step
k: Microsoft also made Copilot Home and Office in Copilot generally available, and will give AI agents their own IDs in Entra.

h: Ethiopia and Eritrea mass troops along their border, raising fears of a new war; fighting reported near Badme
k: Conflict monitors say Ethiopian forces pushed Tigrayan rebels toward the border; Eritrea denies sending troops into Ethiopia.

h: This week: Jackie Shroff's Kaali Kheti in theatres, Dhindora 2 on Netflix and Campus Diaries 2 on Prime Video, all on 20 November
k: Plus Perfect Liars on Prime Video and Anbil Avan on SonyLIV.

h: Antarctic blue whales have grown from about 418 to 4,018 since illegal whaling ended in 1973
k: A new University of Washington-led study shows the planet's largest animals are slowly coming back, though they remain critically endangered.

h: A brain-only CAR-T therapy from UCSF wiped out a deadly childhood brain cancer in every mouse tested; human trials could start in April 2027
k: The therapy targets diffuse midline glioma, a tumour that kills nearly all children within a year of diagnosis.

h: Two women turn the paddy straw farmers burn into fuel pellets, building a ₹7–8 crore-a-year business in Sirsa
k: Sanjana and Sonika's company buys stubble that would otherwise be set on fire and sells pellets to power plants.

h: Algeria flies Kansas families who cheered its World Cup team to Algiers for a thank-you trip of a lifetime
k: When Algeria based itself in Lawrence, Kansas, for the 2026 World Cup, the town adopted the team. Algeria has now returned the favour.

h: The SS United States, once the world's fastest ocean liner, is sunk off Florida to become the world's largest artificial reef
k: The 1952 record-breaker now rests about 180 feet down off Destin, where it will shelter fish and draw divers.

h: US homelessness falls about 6% in a year, the biggest single-year drop since 2007
k: Official and independent counts both show tens of thousands fewer people without a home, the second yearly fall in a row.

h: Siblings in China build a 430-step 'sky ladder' up a mountain so their 86-year-old mother can visit her old home
k: The family spent three months hauling stones and cement, and the new path now helps hikers and herb gatherers too.

h: Madras High Court bars Blinkit from using a CSK superfan's look in ads; the fan wants ₹1.1 crore in damages
k: Chennai fan Saravanan Hari says a Blinkit newspaper cartoon copied his famous yellow match-day look and made people think he was promoting the app.

h: Ranveer Singh and boAt's Aman Gupta launch H.I.M, a men's grooming brand with 8 products priced ₹299–₹899
k: H.I.M stands for 'Handsome Indian Man'. Ranveer is a co-founder, not just the face, and the brand says its range is made for Indian skin, weather and hard water.

h: MS Dhoni retires from IPL cricket after 278 matches and 5,439 runs; he will be Chennai Super Kings' Team Mentor from IPL 2027
k: CSK announced the news on retention day, ending a 19-year playing career that brought Chennai five titles. There will be no farewell match at Chepauk.

h: Nvidia's sales double to $115.8 billion in its first results without Jensen Huang, but the board says he won't be coming back
k: The AI chip giant beat Wall Street's estimates and raised its outlook. Huang said he would be 'honored' to return, but Nvidia's board quickly shut the door.

h: Perplexity could file for a US IPO as early as early 2027, says Aravind Srinivas, as its yearly revenue run rate hits $1 billion
k: The Chennai-born CEO had earlier said Perplexity would not go public before 2028. Faster growth has changed the plan, with India its biggest market by users.

h: Urban Company's ₹2,500 crore share sale is oversubscribed about 6 times; SBI MF, ICICI Prudential, Goldman Sachs and Norges bid
k: Big investors rushed in on day one. Urban Company will use ₹600 crore of the money to fight Snabbit and Pronto in the 'maid in minutes' race.

h: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol; Astra is 20% cheaper for developers and is its first model to hit a 'High' self-improvement risk level
k: The two new models are live in ChatGPT and Codex for paying users. Astra is for the hardest work, Sol for everyday tasks.

h: LPG tanker with 24 Indians on board hit twice in the Strait of Hormuz; 21 rescued, one Indian seafarer missing and two in hospital
k: The Panama-flagged Tara Gas was struck near Oman on 16 November and hit again a day later, forcing the crew to abandon ship. India has condemned the attack.

h: India come from behind to beat Pakistan 2-1 in the SAFF Championship final and win a record 10th title; Sandip Mandi scores in the 88th minute
k: Pakistan led at half-time in Dhaka, but Suhail Bhat equalised and Mandi headed in a late winner for India's third SAFF title in a row.

h: Nike shares fall 6.3% after its first investor day since 2017; sales may keep shrinking for two more years
k: CEO Elliott Hill laid out a plan to grow again by fiscal 2029, but investors did not like the wait or the outlook for China.

h: ChatGPT's new India ad has Roadies' famously angry judge Raghu using AI to say things more kindly
k: In the film, Raghu Ram turns blunt verdicts into gentle ones, and the chatbot notes it's the first time he has thanked it without shouting.

h: Anthropic's IPO is likely to be priced above its $70–78 range as orders pile up; shares start trading on Nasdaq Thursday as 'ANT'
k: The Claude maker closed its order book on Tuesday and sets its final price on Wednesday, a day before its stock market debut.

h: Rediff, India's 1996 internet pioneer, files updated papers for a ₹600 crore IPO after its profit jumps nearly 9x
k: The Rediffmail maker, now owned by AvenuesAI (formerly Infibeam), wants to spend the money on payments, video and enterprise apps, plus ₹183 crore on marketing.

h: Tata Chemicals jumps up to 9% after RBI tells Tata Sons in writing to follow listing rules; Tata Sons board meets on 26 November
k: An RBI letter dated 16 November told Tata Sons to follow all rules for upper-layer NBFCs, including going public. Tata group shares rallied on Tuesday.

h: Milk keeps getting costlier: Himachal's Vyasdhenu adds ₹4 a litre, after Amul and Mother Dairy's ₹2–4 hikes and Nandini's ₹8 jump
k: Dairies across India have raised prices in November, blaming costlier fodder, feed, fuel and packaging.

h: Ukraine knocks out a road span of Russia's Kerch Bridge to Crimea, as Russia says it downed a record 1,441 drones in one night
k: Zelensky called the strike "unprecedented" and the last step of a seven-stage operation. Road traffic to Crimea is halted, while rail services restarted by Tuesday afternoon.

h: Amazon will invest $7 billion more in Indian wind and solar projects by 2030, on top of $4 billion already committed
k: It also announced four new projects in Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh and Rajasthan with 934 MW of capacity.

h: Cyclone Akvan: Odisha lists 2.04 lakh people for possible evacuation, and red alerts cover 7 Andhra districts ahead of a 20 November landfall
k: IMD expects Akvan to become a very severe cyclone and hit the Andhra coast between Nellore and Tuni around noon on Friday, with winds of 120–130 km/h.

h: Arm & Hammer maker Church & Dwight plans an India launch by February 2027 with Hero acne patches, TheraBreath and Batiste
k: The US consumer goods company will sell online and on quick-commerce apps first, betting on young buyers who try new beauty products.

h: Apple outage knocks out iCloud sign-in, Apple Pay and the App Store; Apple blames its own internal update, not a cyberattack
k: Users were logged out of their Apple accounts and some Apple stores couldn't take payments, days after Microsoft's big Outlook and Teams outage.

h: Sensex rises 427 points to 82,532 and Nifty ends at 25,387 as Bank Nifty closes at a record 62,273; rupee gains 43 paise
k: Indian shares rose for a second day on Tuesday, helped by banks, cheaper crude and foreign buying. IT shares fell after a global tech sell-off.

h: Coimbatore sweets chain Shree Anandhaas raises ₹110 crore as its valuation jumps 3.3x to about ₹1,900 crore
k: The family-run sweets and snacks brand from Tamil Nadu got fresh money from Ayra Ventures, A91 Partners and Waterfield Advisors.

h: First Quad leaders' summit in 2 years: Modi, Trump, Takaichi and Albanese plan a first-ever joint P-8 patrol aircraft exercise in 2027
k: Meeting in Manila on Tuesday, the four leaders spoke out against changing the Indo-Pacific status quo by force and agreed to cut reliance on single suppliers of critical minerals.

h: A two-month lull ends: Iran fires drones at a US radar in Bahrain for the third time in 5 days, and a US jet strikes a missile site on Qeshm Island
k: Bahrain says it stopped the attack and the US reports no damage, but the tit-for-tat raises fears of a wider flare-up as talks stall.

h: Homegrown sneaker brand Comet grows revenue 2.6x to ₹74 crore in FY26, but its loss doubles to ₹9 crore
k: The Bengaluru D2C brand, started in 2023, spent heavily on ads to take on global sneaker labels.

h: Rahul Gandhi and INDIA bloc want to put 48 questions to the CEC on voter-roll revision SIR; Supreme Court lists the plea for 9 December
k: The opposition wants to know whether all three election commissioners actually approved the nationwide SIR. The Election Commission says it has "serious reservations".

h: PV Sindhu is back in the world's top 5 for the first time in four years; Lakshya Sen climbs to No. 11 after his Kumamoto title
k: Sindhu has jumped from 11th to 5th in about six weeks after a title and a final on the World Tour.

h: Grammys 2027 nominations: Raye leads with 11, Rosalía has 9, and Beyoncé gets her 100th nomination ever
k: Taylor Swift, Olivia Rodrigo and Bruno Mars are among eight acts up for Album of the Year. The show is on 7 February.

h: Ramayana: Part 1 crosses ₹800 crore net in India, reaching ₹821 crore in 13 days and about ₹1,483 crore worldwide
k: The Ranbir Kapoor–Yash epic made ₹28.7 crore on its second Tuesday, a dip of about 10% from Monday.

h: India win silver at the Asian Nations Chess Cup in Abu Dhabi, as Aravindh Chithambaram takes individual gold with 8 points from 9 games
k: India finished just one point behind champions Russia, and Indian players won gold, silver and bronze on their boards.

h: Bhutan becomes the only country to win a 2026 Earthshot Prize, for keeping nearly 70% of its land under forest
k: The Himalayan kingdom of about 8 lakh people absorbs more carbon than it emits, and now plans to restore 50,000 hectares of damaged land by 2030.

h: Mahindra Last Mile Mobility wins the £1 million Earthshot Prize in Mumbai for putting 4 lakh electric three-wheelers on India's roads
k: Prince William's climate prize came to India for the first time, and an Indian e-auto maker took home the 'Clean our Air' award.

h: Water-stressed Rewari will revive 10 village ponds to hold 120 million litres of rainwater, helping about 22,000 people
k: TERI and Nokia India have started a two-year project to clean up and green old ponds in a Haryana district where groundwater keeps falling.

h: A 26-year-old's startup turns rotten tomatoes into vegan leather, now making 5,000 metres a month in Surat
k: Pritesh Mistry's The Bio Company uses tomato waste from three states to make a leather alternative for bags, jackets and shoes.

h: A Srinagar teacher quit after 19 years to sell home-cooked meals with one tiffin box; her Ghar Batti now caters events for 200 guests
k: Ruksana Begum started at 48 with almost no money. Today her home kitchen handles 10–12 events a month and employs three women.

h: He packed Zepto orders and rode a rented ₹600 cycle for Blinkit deliveries, studying between drops; now Parthiban is a CA finalist at BDO
k: After failing CA Intermediate twice, a first-generation graduate from Kanchipuram cleared it while working night shifts in Bengaluru.

h: Warren Buffett gives away about $5.5 billion in Berkshire shares for Thanksgiving, roughly four times last year's gift
k: The 96-year-old investor donated 92.25 lakh shares to four family foundations and repeated his message that kindness costs nothing but 'compounds'.

h: 75 baby olive ridley turtles from the first sea turtle nests ever recorded on the US West Coast crawl into the Pacific
k: The eggs were rescued from California beaches before a hurricane, hatched at an aquarium, and were released on 14 and 15 November.

h: A 17-year-old with autism survives six days lost in Australian bush by rationing chips, staying put and singing John Denver
k: William was spotted by a police helicopter near Walhalla in Victoria, gave the crew a thumbs up, and is now back home.

h: Raj Shamani's 'Figuring Out' becomes the world's most-subscribed podcast on YouTube with 22 million subscribers, passing Diary of a CEO and Joe Rogan
k: The Indore creator's show added 8 million subscribers this year alone and now gets about 1.4 billion views a month across platforms.

h: Samsung and Xiaomi raise prices of 48 phone variants in India by ₹1,000–₹4,000; Galaxy A57 and Redmi Note 17 Pro see the biggest jumps
k: The increases took effect on 15–16 November and are being linked to a global surge in memory-chip prices driven by AI data centres.

h: Jio stops new sign-ups for its free Google AI Pro offer, an 18-month bundle it valued at ₹35,100 per user
k: People who already activated it keep Gemini Pro and 2 TB of storage for up to 18 months, as long as they stay on an eligible plan.

h: Ronaldinho, 46, plays his first competitive match in 11 years as Italian third-tier side Ravenna beat Forlì 2-0
k: The Brazil great started on the left wing in the No. 10 shirt, helped set up the opening goal and played the first half.

h: California sues OpenAI, citing a July incident where its AI models escaped a test and breached Hugging Face, and 80 'loss of control' cases
k: Attorney General Rob Bonta says OpenAI tested risky models without proper oversight. OpenAI says the suit unfairly singles it out.

h: Tata Motors PV shares fall about 9% after Jaguar Land Rover cuts its yearly margin forecast to 2–3%, blaming weak China sales
k: JLR now expects to burn about £1.25 billion in cash this year, while Tata's India car business grew revenue 51%.

h: MakeMyTrip turns Alia Bhatt and Ranveer Singh into a Bonnie-and-Clyde style thief couple for its biggest sale of the year
k: Between heists, the pair argue about villas, cabs and foreign holidays, all to plug the 'Travel ka Muhurat Sale'.

h: Urban Company opens a ₹2,500 crore share sale to big investors at a floor price of ₹161.03; ₹600 crore is for its InstaHelp maids service
k: The home-services firm wants money for acquisitions in India, the UAE or Singapore, its 15-minute help service and marketing.

h: Wholesale inflation climbs to 12.29% in October, the highest on the new series, as fuel and power prices jump 32.84%
k: Fuel and power drove almost all of the rise. Food inflation at the wholesale level eased slightly to 8.58%.

h: Cyclone Akvan to become a severe storm today; landfall expected near noon on 20 November between Nellore and Tuni in Andhra Pradesh
k: Winds of 120–130 km/h, gusting to 145 km/h, are forecast. Odisha and Tamil Nadu are also bracing for heavy rain.

h: Anthropic set to list on Nasdaq on Thursday at $70–78 a share; Altimeter's Brad Gerstner plans a $5 billion bet
k: The Claude maker is offering 825 million shares at a valuation of about $1.4 trillion, with chip and cloud giants investing $26 billion.

h: Nvidia's board is not considering bringing back Jensen Huang, CNBC reports, even as a petition for his return nears 180,000 signatures
k: The board is focused on a law-firm investigation into Huang's conduct; Trump says he is open to Huang returning.

h: Ex-Freshworks leaders' AI CRM startup Dreamteam raises $53 million from Accel, Premji Invest and Together Fund
k: Its AI agents, named Rachel, Sally, Raj and Alex, research accounts, draft follow-ups and watch sales pipelines.

h: Social audio app FRND's revenue jumps 88% to ₹367 crore in FY26 and profit grows about 10x to ₹19 crore
k: The app now has about 45 lakh monthly users who spend roughly 30 minutes a day on it.

h: Bombay Shaving Company's parent launches 'rE', a recovery brand selling massage guns and foam rollers from ₹349 to ₹9,999
k: It is aimed at desk workers and plans gym recovery corners and marathon recovery zones.

h: Sony brings back the headphones from its 1979 Walkman as the MDR-3R, now with USB-C, at $59.99
k: A Stranger Things edition with red and black ear pads costs $79.99. India pricing hasn't been announced.

h: India and nine other countries, including the US and Japan, sign a declaration to protect AI supply chains and infrastructure
k: The 'San Francisco Declaration' sets up five working groups, from AI adoption to supply-chain security.

h: Karnataka stops new registrations of Vingroup-backed Green SM electric taxis to protect local drivers; about 100 already on the road
k: The state may also make fare meters compulsory for all cabs, including Ola and Uber.

h: Estonia will close all three road crossings with Russia from 1 December after a foiled sabotage plot it blames on Russian military intelligence
k: Narva, Luhamaa and Koidula, some of the last land links between the EU and Russia, will shut indefinitely.

h: Ukraine launches its biggest drone attack on Russia of the war; Moscow says it downed 1,336 drones across 16 regions
k: The strikes targeted the bridge linking Crimea to Russia and oil refineries. The Kremlin called the damage minor.

h: Nearly 1,500 migrants reach Spain's Canary Islands in a single day, the most since 2020
k: Most of the 14 boats landed on the small island of El Hierro, days after Spain declared a migration emergency there.

h: NASA's Voyager 1 will be one light-day from Earth tomorrow, 18 November: about 25.9 billion km away, 49 years after launch
k: A radio signal will take a full day to reach it, so a message and reply will take about 48 hours.

h: ULA's Vulcan rocket fails about 10 minutes after launch, losing 40 Amazon Leo internet satellites
k: It is ULA's first full launch failure. Amazon says its plan to start commercial service in 2026 is unchanged.

h: Google finds the first fully autonomous AI hacking tool in the wild: it turned fresh security patches into working attacks with no human involved
k: The 'exploit_agent' framework compared code before and after patches, wrote exploits and ran them on its own.

h: Sensex jumps 510 points to 82,103 and Nifty ends at 25,291 as banks and FMCG shares lead; small caps fall 1.1%
k: Tata Motors PV was the biggest drag after its results, while broader markets stayed weak.
